name: Arles
source:
"I prefer human life."

A half-human half-demon with white white who became Raoul's familiar. He's homey and good at cooking. He's usually kind, but can be scary if angered.

He's friendly to humans and is an honest, polite person.

[Translated from [url=https://www.pandora.nu/kuro/game/tukai/t_chara.htm]official website[/url]]
